statement: After finite coordinate roots and any sequence of point blowups over the origin, H1 of the actual Jacobian log-torus sheaf vanishes, so the nontrivial actual punctured axial torsor has no locally trivial extension on that modified base
depends_on: B.4.24; KKN2008Root Lemma1.2.9; explicit blowup Picard and ghost cohomology

notes: Root and boundary_d passed the full proof. The bounded first character excludes only the strict r-axis; exceptional divisor classes kill Pic and exceptional valuation matrices inject H2(Y) into H2(Tlog). The proof covers all finite sequences; code audits 124 marked sequences. No assertion that an arbitrary flattened analytic cap defines such a torsor.
